title: 二叉树的堂兄弟节点 II
summary: 把二叉树每个节点值替换为同深度所有非兄弟节点原值之和，返回修改后的树。
insight: 按层处理父节点。先求所有下一层孩子的原值总和 total；再对每个父节点求其左右孩子原值之和 siblingSum，把每个孩子改成 total-siblingSum。两遍分开可避免修改值污染总和。根没有堂兄弟，置零。
pitfalls: 兄弟包括同一父节点的另一个孩子，也排除节点自身
必须先完成整层原值求和再修改

solutions.title: 逐层两遍计算堂兄弟和
solutions.idea: 每层先汇总下一层，再按父节点扣除兄弟组。
steps: 第一遍遍历 level，求所有孩子原值 nextTotal
第二遍对每个 parent 求 siblingSum=left.val+right.val
把存在的每个孩子改为 nextTotal-siblingSum 并加入 nextLevel

code.java: class Solution { public TreeNode replaceValueInTree(TreeNode root){root.val=0;List<TreeNode> level=new ArrayList<>();level.add(root);while(!level.isEmpty()){int nextTotal=0;for(TreeNode node:level){if(node.left!=null)nextTotal+=node.left.val;if(node.right!=null)nextTotal+=node.right.val;}List<TreeNode> nextLevel=new ArrayList<>();for(TreeNode node:level){int siblingSum=(node.left==null?0:node.left.val)+(node.right==null?0:node.right.val);if(node.left!=null){node.left.val=nextTotal-siblingSum;nextLevel.add(node.left);}if(node.right!=null){node.right.val=nextTotal-siblingSum;nextLevel.add(node.right);}}level=nextLevel;}return root;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun replaceValueInTree(root:TreeNode?):TreeNode?{if(root==null)return null;root.`val`=0;var level=listOf(root);while(level.isNotEmpty()){var nextTotal=0;for(node in level){nextTotal+=node.left?.`val`?:0;nextTotal+=node.right?.`val`?:0};val nextLevel=mutableListOf<TreeNode>();for(node in level){val siblingSum=(node.left?.`val`?:0)+(node.right?.`val`?:0);node.left?.let{it.`val`=nextTotal-siblingSum;nextLevel.add(it)};node.right?.let{it.`val`=nextTotal-siblingSum;nextLevel.add(it)}};level=nextLevel};return root} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:TreeNode* replaceValueInTree(TreeNode* root){root->val=0;vector<TreeNode*> level{root};while(!level.empty()){int nextTotal=0;for(auto* node:level){if(node->left)nextTotal+=node->left->val;if(node->right)nextTotal+=node->right->val;}vector<TreeNode*> nextLevel;for(auto* node:level){int siblingSum=(node->left?node->left->val:0)+(node->right?node->right->val:0);if(node->left){node->left->val=nextTotal-siblingSum;nextLevel.push_back(node->left);}if(node->right){node->right->val=nextTotal-siblingSum;nextLevel.push_back(node->right);}}level.swap(nextLevel);}return root;} };
